decisive_spans.text: He reported prior trauma to his nasal skin
multiple papules and pustules on an erythematous base over the nasal dorsum, some with superficial ulceration and yellow crusting

response.rationale: D3 (Lupus miliaris disseminatus faciei) is strongly supported by the chronic nature of the lesions, their localization to the nose, the presence of papules and pustules, and the history of trauma. The description of 'superficial ulceration and yellow crusting' further aligns with this diagnosis. D1 (Rosacea) is a possible contender given the papules and pustules on an erythematous base, but the history of trauma and the specific description of ulceration and crusting make D3 a better fit. The lack of systemic symptoms also supports D3 over other systemic conditions.
